rule: 3 models are within 0.005 validation AUC of the best ('densenet121', 1.0000); 'efficientnet_b0' has the fewest parameters among them.
caution: Trivial-feature baseline (brightness, black margins, tissue extent, file size; no anatomy) reaches test AUC 0.926; the best CNN reaches 1.000 (difference +0.074). The baseline is already very high, so these CNN scores do NOT show that the models learned ovarian pathology: the classes are separable by image characteristics alone (different sources/framing). Do not interpret differences between models as clinical performance.
